plugins.name: loopd
plugins.description: The OKF control panel as a Claude Code plugin — /brief-me, /capture, /work, /dispatch, /handoff, /welcome, /new-project, /close-project, /answer, /audit, /board, /fanout, /pr-review-request, plus the two PreToolUse enforcement hooks, the eight role agents and three mods (usage, pane, signal) that are each a /config switch.

plugins.name: loopd-yolo
plugins.description: COMPANION to loopd. Ships AUTONOMY.md, the capability file that defines the `yolo` mode — the loop may promote fully-refined build drafts and merge on an independent clearance. Not installed = every project is gated. A companion ADDS behaviour and never removes a core gate.
